facts.text: The wedding set up in the family barn
facts.why: In the transcript Grace and Annie say they will hold the wedding in the barn, a Paxton family tradition, and Andrew later stands alone in a barn.

facts.text: Ramone runs the store, the bar and the wedding
facts.why: Wikipedia's cast list gives Ramone the jobs of waiter, male stripper, shopkeeper and minister. He dances at the bar but nothing shows him running it.
facts.fix: Ramone runs the store, dances at the bar, marries them

vibe.verdict: Sitka, the boat line, the fake heart attack and Ramone all print, but the lodge card is plain and the poster sits as a white block.
